# sendgrid_image (Resource)

Manages an image uploaded to SendGrid's CDN for use in email templates.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `file_path` (String) Path to the image file to upload.
- `file_sha256` (String) SHA256 hash of the file content. Use `filesha256(...)` to compute. Changes force replacement.

### Read-Only

- `height` (Number) Image height in pixels.
- `id` (String) The image ID.
- `name` (String) The filename as stored in SendGrid.
- `url` (String) The CDN URL of the uploaded image.
- `width` (Number) Image width in pixels.
